{{Quote|I'd rather that the route be by skycar to the rooftop pad.''"<br />"''I'm sorry, Qui-Gon. He insists on arriving by ground-effect vehicle.|Quin-Gon Jinn and Adi Gallia|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
A '''skycar''' was a means of transport that used hover technology to take to the air. It generally had a capacity of four seats.<ref name="CoD" />
